0.name: Disciplined Saver
0.description: Consistent high surplus, strong savings allocation, and disciplined discretionary spending.
0.recommendation: Great financial resilience! Consider exploring tax-advantaged investments, emergency liquid reserves, and medium-term growth assets.

2.name: Balanced Spender
2.description: Stable financial rhythm with moderate savings and managed daily living expenses.
2.recommendation: Healthy baseline. Look for opportunities to trim recurring subscriptions and automate a 5% increase to your monthly savings.

1.name: High-Outflow Spender
1.description: Expenses consume nearly all (or more than) total income, leaving minimal reserve for unexpected events.
1.recommendation: High priority: conduct a category audit to identify non-essential discretionary costs and build a ₹10,000 baseline emergency buffer.
